settings.heading: Refunds & cancellations
settings.intro: How to cancel a reservation, and how refunds work.
settings.fallback_content:
Refunds and cancellations are handled by [Legal].

Cancel before dispatch

You can cancel any time before your mattress is dispatched for a full refund.

How to cancel

Email or WhatsApp us with your order number. No forms designed to slow you down.

Timing and method

Refunds return to the original payment method within 5-10 business days of cancellation confirmation.

After delivery

Once it arrives you still have [return_words] days to decide if the bed itself is wrong. If it is, we collect it and refund you.

Comfort layers

Layers sent under Adjust to Desire stay with you. They are not returned and they are not refunded as a separate line.

Who to contact

Use the email or WhatsApp on our contact page. We reply within one working day.
